info.title: Allied AutoTech API
info.description: Versioned REST API contracts for Allied AutoTech. When PUBLIC_LAUNCH_MODE=browse_enquiries, customer transaction writes return 403 while public catalogue reads, enquiries and existing authentication remain available. Staff and administrator operations retain their normal permission checks.

get.description: Disabled by default. Requires enabled reviewed learning, server-only provider settings and a positive shared daily reservation budget. Current verified identity/MFA and session-bound ownership are resolved on every protected operation. Public sessions are separate secure opaque cookies and never silently join an account. All writes require trusted Origin; account writes use existing CSRF, guest writes additionally verify the guest CSRF header. Conversation and turn creation use scoped operation IDs. Only typed questions and eligible reviewed help reach the provider; no business lookup/mutation tools. Output sources/actions are validated, state encrypted with short expiry, budget/concurrency shared in PostgreSQL. Persistence is automated help, not a Customer Care case, live staffing or human delivery. All responses private/no-store; no transcript URL parameters. Limited catalogue mode retains its public-write restrictions. Allie list. Access boundary: public. Requires the opaque session cookie. No CSRF token is required. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.

post.summary: Prepare an owner-bound profile photo upload
post.description: Customer owner only. Admin/Staff/Super Admin are denied personal-media access. CSRF required. Profile uploads allow JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 5 MiB, 32–8192 pixels per dimension and at most 40 million pixels, one non-animated image. Backend checks bytes, checksum, signature and complete decoding, rotates and re-encodes to WebP (maximum 1024px), stripping metadata. Upload does not publish media. Confirmation binds the token to actor/owner/profile/purpose/object/checksum/expiry. expectedVersion is profile.mediaVersion, independent of profile text editing. Exact confirmation retries with the same token and body replay the safe result for 24 hours; different replay is MEDIA_TICKET_CONSUMED. Expired unconfirmed tickets fail even if transfer finished. On uncertain confirmation, reread the profile before another mutation. Replacement failure preserves the previous image. Removed/replaced objects use transactional retryable cleanup; unattached uploads are cleaned after upload expiry plus one hour, cascaded resource deletions after one hour. Signed PUT credentials are present only in this preparation response, never resource reads or audits. Private bytes are served via authenticated no-store media routes; no signed read URL is returned. No separate Idempotency-Key is required: the confirmation token is the idempotency identity. Prepare an owner-bound profile photo upload. Access boundary: authenticated-customer. Requires the opaque session cookie. Requires a current session-bound CSRF header. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.

patch.summary: Edit garage image alt text, order or cover
patch.description: Customer owner only; all other roles denied. Private garage photos never publish to the marketplace. JPEG/PNG/WebP, non-animated, max 10 MiB each, 32–8192px per side, 40 million input pixels, re-encoded metadata-free WebP within 2048px; extreme aspect ratios below 32 output pixels rejected. At most 12 images. Prepare does not attach bytes. Confirmation verifies full bytes/checksum and ticket actor/owner/vehicle/purpose/expiry. expectedVersion is vehicle.mediaVersion; all gallery mutations serialize on the vehicle and reject stale versions. Exact confirmation token/body retries replay for 24 hours; changed-body replay fails. Images sort by sortOrder ascending then stable image ID; duplicate order numbers are allowed. First attachment becomes cover; select another using isPrimary:true. Cover cannot be unset without replacement. Removing the cover chooses the first remaining image by the same ordering; removing the final image is allowed. Removal or vehicle deletion revokes reads and queues owned-object cleanup transactionally; foreign-key restrictions on vehicle deletion remain intact. GET vehicle includes bounded images and mediaVersion. Display uses authenticated GET /customers/media/images/{imageId}, private/no-store. No public URLs, object keys or upload tokens appear in vehicle projections. See managed-media.md for retention and storage requirements. Edit garage image alt text, order or cover. Access boundary: authenticated-customer. Requires the opaque session cookie. Requires a current session-bound CSRF header. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.

post.summary: Prepare a product-bound binary image upload
post.description: ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN with verified MFA. Preserves the separate hosted-URL POST /admin/catalog/products/{productId}/images contract. JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 10 MiB, non-animated, 32–8192px per side, 40 million pixels, re-encoded metadata-free WebP within 2048px. Full bytes/signature/checksum/decoding verified. Tickets bind actor/product/purpose/expiry. Confirmation uses Product.mediaVersion and returns the new image only plus the new version; reread the product for the complete gallery. Exact token/body retries replay for 24h, changed replay fails. All image mutations share a product lock and increment mediaVersion; legacy hosted CRUD may omit expectedVersion, new clients should send it. At most 12 total hosted/uploaded images can be attached; older larger galleries remain readable/editable/removable. Ordering is sortOrder then image ID. isPrimary:true clears the prior primary; false is allowed and first attachment is not automatically primary. Deleting/clearing a primary does not select another, preserving existing behavior. Managed URLs are server-owned and cannot be edited through hosted metadata PATCH. Removal queues only owned storage for cleanup; external files are never deleted. Public bytes require active product and category. Read projections expose source UPLOADED/EXTERNAL, nullable dimensions and safe display URLs; never storage keys or tokens. See managed-media.md. Prepare a product-bound binary image upload. Access boundary: mfa-verified-admin. Requires the opaque session cookie. Requires a current session-bound CSRF header. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.

get.summary: Search public products with exact totals and stable paging
get.description: Anonymous. Active products in active categories with active parents only. Normalized vehicleModelId plus year (1886-2200), optional matching vehicleMakeId and technical qualifiers use approved inclusion evidence before counts and paging. fitment=verified requires a full technical match and no possible approved exclusion; make/model/year alone are candidates. verifiedMatches counts genuine verified results in the same repeatable-read snapshot. Legacy literal make/model filters remain available but expose only approved inclusion rules. Filters include condition (NEW/USED/REFURBISHED), classification (GENUINE_OEM/AFTERMARKET), stored productType, categoryId and parentCategoryId (direct subcategories), plus literal substring search across name, SKU, brand and manufacturer part number. minPriceKobo/maxPriceKobo are inclusive integer kobo (0-9999999999999999); availability=in_stock means at least one active branch has quantity greater than reserved, out_of_stock is its complement, including products with no inventory. No raw stock quantities are exposed. Maximum 50/default 20. totalMatches counts the filtered dataset before the cursor in the same repeatable-read transaction as the page. Sort and all filters are bound into authenticated cursors; page size may change. Deleted/unpublished anchors remain usable. Legacy UUID anchors require a currently visible matching product. Invalid/tampered/mismatched cursors return 422 VALIDATION_FAILED; restart from page one. Sort ties use ID; no cross-request snapshot/cache is promised. Price, name, stock or visibility edits can move products between reads. Existing /public/catalog/products remains supported. Search public products with exact totals and stable paging. Access boundary: public. Does not accept browser bearer tokens. No CSRF token is required. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.

get.summary: Search catalogue category, brand and compatibility options
get.description: Anonymous. Bounded options backed by active products in active categories, including out-of-stock products. field=category returns category UUID values and stored names; empty categories are omitted. Other fields collapse case variants into lowercase values with deterministic stored labels. Models require an exact case-insensitive make; make is forbidden for other fields. Optional categoryId scopes non-category options. search is a literal case-insensitive prefix (1-120 characters; percent/underscore escaped). Null models for make-wide compatibility do not become named model options; existing product compatibility filtering semantics are preserved. Options sort by lowercase label then value under C collation. Maximum 50/default 20. Authenticated cursors bind field/categoryId/make/search, survive deleted anchors, and reject tampering/filter changes with 422 VALIDATION_FAILED. No nextCursor means the current option search is complete. No global total or cross-request snapshot/cache is promised. Search catalogue category, brand and compatibility options. Access boundary: public. Does not accept browser bearer tokens. No CSRF token is required. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.

Legacy UUID anchors must still match. Page and count share a repeatable-read snapshot; concurrent edits may move records between requests. Inactive categories are omitted from metadata but do not unpublish services. Search active services with exact totals. Access boundary: public. Does not accept browser bearer tokens. Maximum 50, default 20. totalMatches is the exact filtered count before pagination, read in the same repeatable-read transaction as the page; no cross-request snapshot or cache is promised. nextCursor is authenticated and bound to the filters and sort (page size may change). Deleted or unpublished anchors remain usable. Invalid, tampered or mismatched cursors return 422 VALIDATION_FAILED; restart at the first page. Mutable price/year/visibility changes can move records between pages; refresh to see current inventory. UUID cursors from old links are accepted only while their anchor is currently public and matches the query. Existing /public/vehicles behavior and UUID cursor responses remain supported. No private stock, VIN, acquisition or customer fields are exposed. Search public vehicles with exact totals and stable paging. Access boundary: public. Does not accept browser bearer tokens. No CSRF token is required. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.

No exact total or persistent cache is implied; inventory can change between reads. Search published vehicle make or model options. Access boundary: public. Does not accept browser bearer tokens. get.summary: List branch vehicle inventory; acquisition costs are administrator-only
get.description: Private, no-store staff stock discovery. Existing active assigned-branch Staff and cross-branch Admin/Super Admin/MFA policy is unchanged. Search is a literal case-insensitive substring across stock number, make, model and VIN; exact make/model matching also treats percent, underscore and backslash literally. Optional listed=true selects records with any listing; listed=false selects records with none and cannot be combined with listing-specific filters. Status, featured and price bounds must match the same stored listing, including history. Newest, year and mileage sorts use an ID tie-breaker and cursor paging; price sorting is not accepted because a stock record can have multiple historical listing prices. The stock UI currently exposes search, exact make/model, year, branch and listing filters. List branch vehicle inventory; acquisition costs are administrator-only. Access boundary: mfa-verified-staff. Requires the opaque session cookie. No CSRF token is required. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.

post.description: Change listing price with history. Access boundary: mfa-verified-staff. Requires the opaque session cookie. Requires a current session-bound CSRF header. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.

STAFF requires an active assigned branch matching the vehicle; ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN retain existing cross-branch authority. All require verified MFA. Writes require CSRF. IMAGE preparation and confirmation retain their original paths and response fields; image confirmations may omit expectedVersion for old clients, but new clients send Vehicle.version. Every image mutation serializes on the vehicle row and increments that same version. PATCH/DELETE require expectedVersion. IMAGE uploads use shared actor/owner/vehicle/purpose/branch-bound tickets, 10 MiB, 20-image limit, JPEG/PNG/WebP, full checksum/signature/decoding, 32-8192px sides and 40MP, sanitized WebP output within 2048px. Still-valid old encrypted IMAGE tickets undergo the same verification; non-image asset contracts are unchanged. Exact confirmation token/body replay lasts 24h; changed replay conflicts. Failed attachments preserve old images. Optional replaceImageId on IMAGE preparation/confirmation supports replacement at the gallery limit; confirmation also requires expectedVersion. It attaches verified new bytes before detaching the old image in the same transaction, preserves its primary selection and queues owned cleanup. The old image remains intact on any failure. sortOrder is an integer 0-10000; ties use image ID, deletion leaves remaining positions unchanged. isPrimary:true replaces the previous primary; false may clear it. Deleting the primary selects the first remaining image. Deleting the last image while any AVAILABLE or RESERVED listing exists fails MEDIA_LAST_PUBLISHED_IMAGE (409), including inactive branches. Publishing AVAILABLE now requires an active branch, a positive asking price and at least one photo. Publication and photo removal serialize in vehicle-then-listing order. Owner-reported condition/issues are public attributed statements, separate from inspection evidence; corrections use Vehicle.version and retain before/after audit notes. Deletion queues managed or recognized legacy owned keys in the same transaction; external files are never deleted. Preview is authenticated and branch scoped; public bytes require an AVAILABLE listing at an active branch. All byte responses are no-store; subsequent reads revoke immediately on detach. Read projections contain safe URLs, source and nullable dimensions, no keys/tickets. See managed-media.md. Authorize a bounded object upload. Access boundary: mfa-verified-staff. get.description: STAFF requires an active assigned branch matching the vehicle; ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN retain existing cross-branch authority. All require verified MFA. Writes require CSRF. IMAGE preparation and confirmation retain their original paths and response fields; image confirmations may omit expectedVersion for old clients, but new clients send Vehicle.version. Every image mutation serializes on the vehicle row and increments that same version. PATCH/DELETE require expectedVersion. IMAGE uploads use shared actor/owner/vehicle/purpose/branch-bound tickets, 10 MiB, 20-image limit, JPEG/PNG/WebP, full checksum/signature/decoding, 32-8192px sides and 40MP, sanitized WebP output within 2048px. Still-valid old encrypted IMAGE tickets undergo the same verification; non-image asset contracts are unchanged. Exact confirmation token/body replay lasts 24h; changed replay conflicts. Failed attachments preserve old images. Optional replaceImageId on IMAGE preparation/confirmation supports replacement at the gallery limit; confirmation also requires expectedVersion. It attaches verified new bytes before detaching the old image in the same transaction, preserves its primary selection and queues owned cleanup. The old image remains intact on any failure. sortOrder is an integer 0-10000; ties use image ID, deletion leaves remaining positions unchanged. isPrimary:true replaces the previous primary; false may clear it. Deleting the primary selects the first remaining image. Deleting the last image while any AVAILABLE or RESERVED listing exists fails MEDIA_LAST_PUBLISHED_IMAGE (409), including inactive branches. Publishing AVAILABLE now requires an active branch, a positive asking price and at least one photo. Publication and photo removal serialize in vehicle-then-listing order. Owner-reported condition/issues are public attributed statements, separate from inspection evidence; corrections use Vehicle.version and retain before/after audit notes. Deletion queues managed or recognized legacy owned keys in the same transaction; external files are never deleted. Preview is authenticated and branch scoped; public bytes require an AVAILABLE listing at an active branch. All byte responses are no-store; subsequent reads revoke immediately on detach. Read projections contain safe URLs, source and nullable dimensions, no keys/tickets. See managed-media.md. Read branch-scoped stock image preview. Access boundary: mfa-verified-staff. Requires the opaque session cookie. No CSRF token is required. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.

post.summary: Verify an online payment attempt with its stored provider
post.description: Requires the customer account that owns the payment; server verification remains authoritative. Successful provider facts are immutable. Each distinct provider receipt is recorded once; reuse of its transaction identity on another attempt is held for review without a second credit. Different receipts on an already-settled payment are retained without settling the payable twice. Positive NGN amount mismatches record the actual received amount under review. Repeated mismatch reports are idempotent; conflicting later observations are retained as anomalies. A wrong reference, unsupported currency, missing transaction identity or non-positive successful amount is held for reconciliation without inventing NGN capture facts. Such a hold blocks checkout replay and new attempts, and is not automatically cleared by later reports. Mismatched funds are not automatically allocated or refunded. Verify an online payment attempt with its stored provider. Access boundary: authenticated-customer. Requires the opaque session cookie. Requires a current session-bound CSRF header. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.

Unknown outcomes are never retried automatically. Queued/Saved does not establish email delivery or human reading. Requires compatible backend before frontend exposure; no new schema. End preserves the case and ordinary follow-up. Live access cannot be inferred from account role. Transactionally claim, transfer or end the canonical human channel. Access boundary: authenticated-customer. Requires the opaque session cookie. Requires a current session-bound CSRF header. Requires an Idempotency-Key; a key may only be replayed with the identical request.

post.summary: Retry a failed job using optimistic attempt matching
post.description: Requires Admin or Super Admin, verified MFA and CSRF; current actor/session is rechecked within the mutation transaction. expectedAttempts must match the current job, including zero for notifications queued while delivery was disabled. Optional expectedUpdatedAt must match the inspected revision or the request returns409 without a change. Legacy callers may omit it. Only FAILED or DEAD_LETTER jobs are retryable. Notification outbox retries atomically reset their matching failed delivery and append an audit event; missing, active, completed or mismatched delivery records return 409 without changing the job. Attempts and provider idempotency keys are preserved. A webhook retry queues one further attempt even after its automatic eight-attempt budget is exhausted; failure after that budget returns to DEAD_LETTER, and a further retry requires another audited request. RETRY_REQUESTED means queued, not delivered or settled; workers still enforce consent, message eligibility, provider verification and financial authorization. Retry a failed job using optimistic attempt matching. Access boundary: mfa-verified-admin. Requires the opaque session cookie. Requires a current session-bound CSRF header. get.description: Inclusive Africa/Lagos calendar range, maximum 90 days. Scope derives from the authenticated actor, with active-branch enforcement for STAFF. Booking/order/inspection/vehicle counts use creation dates; quotations use issue dates. Status breakdowns reflect current status. Administrator payment sums use succeededAt and verified settled attempts; refunds use processedAt. Currencies remain separate. Recent records are bounded previews, never the source of aggregate counts. CUSTOMER alone receives care: bounded own-account current previews independent of the historical range. Current booking selects latest updated IN_PROGRESS; next booking selects earliest future REQUESTED/CONFIRMED. Vehicle is the owned vehicle linked to that booking, otherwise the latest garage addition. Quote is the latest unexpired ISSUED quote. Payment is the latest unexpired REQUIRES_PAYMENT or unresolved PROCESSING/REQUIRES_REVIEW request, not a debt balance. Order is the latest created order with actual fulfillment method/status. Inspection prioritizes earliest future confirmed/rescheduled appointment, otherwise nearest future requested date. Notification is the latest unexpired own notification. Preview ties use IDs; absence is null and never an aggregate zero. Staff responses omit care. Read own date-filtered dashboard aggregates. Access boundary: authenticated-customer. Requires the opaque session cookie. No CSRF token is required. This operation has no idempotency-key contract.
